Material properties of diamond.fact: Some diamonds found in Brazil and the Democratic Republic of the Congo are polycrystalline and occur as opaque, darkly colored, spherical, radial masses of tiny crystals; these are called ballas and are important to industry as they lack the cleavage planes of single-crystal diamond.
